reader_summary.overview: Ben and David are once again live on the scene, this time covering the biggest disruption in grocery since… well, sliced bread. We place this deal in context by diving deep into the long, intertwining history of grocery, tech and Amazon. One thing is clear: for Amazon and Jeff Bezos, realizing the longterm vision of the Everything Store truly means building the everything store.
